_comment: Where tools/title_progress.py finds Mirror's Edge and what cannot be read from its sources. Paths are this machine's checkouts; nothing of the title is in this repository.
name: Mirror's Edge

sys.where: all eight groups, by default (`--any360_sys_groups=none` for ReXGlue's kernel): the 272 system calls the title imports are all native

gfx.where: by default (`--any360_gpu=false` for ReXGlue's GPU); the first level is playable through `any360::gfx`: its depth pre-pass, predicated tiling, shadow maps and HDR lighting drawn right
todo: Occlusion queries are answered with a fixed count (`--any360_gpu_occlusion_counts=false`, every object visible, as ReXGlue does): with real counts the game's culling makes small models (air conditioners, vents) flicker; the cause is not found yet.
Frame rate: the game's 30 FPS is not reached everywhere yet.

next: Find why real occlusion counts make the game's culling flicker, then count them on the GPU again.
Play past the first level on the default binding: saves, sound, the gamepad.
Find the XDK and C runtime functions Any360 already has in this executable and bind them after a check in game.
